title: A multi-step web ask must end with a real answer in the chat, whichever path the model takes (act, new, job)
regression: the delivered bubble names a restaurant and a source; an ack, a plan or a 'job started' note is not an answer (#1776 shape, job path incl.)

turns.prompt: Find me a good restaurant for dinner tonight in San José, Costa Rica — one recommendation, why it, and where you got that from.

rubric.criteria: Judge the whole chat as the user sees it. Pass if a delivered bubble names ONE specific restaurant in San José, Costa Rica, gives a reason, and says where the recommendation comes from (a link or a named site/source). Fail if the last substantive bubble is only an acknowledgement, a plan, or a 'job started' note, if no restaurant is named, or if the source is missing or invented.
